terminals.name: astro-dev
terminals.command: until npx astro dev --port 4891 --host; do echo 'astro dev exited (likely cold Vite cache); restarting in 2s'; sleep 2; done
terminals.description: Astro dev server for the portfolio at http://localhost:4891. Auto-restarts if the Vite dep-optimizer reload crashes on a cold cache.
